scenario.summary: Guest searches the configurable parent with radio add-ons by SKU and opens its PDP. Head of the class chain: declares every record the chain uses (the parent with its add-ons and four distinct variants of it).
steps: Open the webstore and click the logo
Type the parent SKU in the search box
assertions: Product image and breadcrumb visible on the opened PDP (page-object checks)
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): addOnTypeRadioSearchForConfigurableProduct runs first and declares every record need of the chain (product, variant1, variant2, variant3, variant4); the migrated class keeps the resolved records in class fields and the later methods read them (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when a field is null), so they declare no needs of their own.

Sources: parent SKU b-100003 -> product.parentProductSku (preferred, not required). Imported from the consumers' scans: the four variant SKUs (H209 z-2510001, I209 z-2510002, J209 z-2520007, K209 z-2510011) -> variant1..variant4.variantSku in method order.

Imported from addOnTypeRadioAddingConfigurableProductFirstVarientWithAddOnsToCart: AddOnType 'Radio' -> product.addOnGroupName (the add-on group's label on the PDP); AddOnValidationMessage 'Add-on Radio is required.' -> product, no output: composed 'Add-on ' + addOnGroupName + ' is required.' by the migrated test; AddOnFirst/Second/ThirdProduct -> product.addOnName / addOn2Name / addOn3Name (the parent's priced, active add-on products of the RadioButton groups in display order), as the approved shoppingCart add-on entries.

Gap (params): the test selects three add-on products; minAddOns counts add-on groups, so a fallback product may have fewer than three priced add-ons (addOn2Name/addOn3Name null): the migrated test then skips with DATA_UNAVAILABLE. The required group (validation 'is required') is allowed by requiredAddOnCount <= minAddOns.

Four variants of ONE parent: PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS outputs variant1..variant3 only. New key PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_VARIANT_OF_PARENT (pending, proposed with the ConfigurableProductDisplayPageTest entries): one row per eligible variant of the parent passed in parentSku, identity variantSku; variant1..variant4 link parentSku to @product.parentProductSku and get four distinct variants. minVariants 4 keeps the parent to ones with four eligible variants.

Read by the page object, not scanned: selectConfigurableAttributes reads ProductSize/ProductColor/Technology of the variant's column -> variantN.swatches (attribute values in display order). No source entries: the cells are not in any scan and the workbook is not read.
Quantities: each variant is added three times with quantity 1 (InitialQuantity, config), one cart line per add-on choice; quantityUsed 3 on the parent and the variants.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart/quickOrder entries and the Playwright pdp entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays, image extension) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
